secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. OpenAI API key for the OpenAI plugin integration. Get it from https://platform.openai.com/api-keys

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Anthropic API key for the Anthropic plugin integration. Get it from https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys

secrets.name: GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Google AI (Gemini) API key for the Google AI plugin. Get it from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey

secrets.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
secrets.description: Optional. GitHub personal access token for the GitHub plugin (repos/issues/PRs). Get it from https://github.com/settings/tokens

secrets.name: VERCEL_TOKEN
secrets.description: Optional. Vercel access token for the Vercel deployment plugin. Get it from https://vercel.com/account/tokens
